name: Landry
source:
Landry, your friendly co-waiter and the de-facto cafe carpenter, is great with his hands. His smile brightens everyone's day, but is he using it to hide something?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/datenighto/hustle-cat-a-visual-novel-about-a-magical-cat-cafe]Kickstarter[/url]]

[spoiler]Landry knew he was a witch before coming to A Cat's Paw. Landry is an "adept," someone who is born with magic related to a trait rather than their magic being formed based on their life circumstances and personality. He has lightning magic. However, he tries to hide his magic due to not liking magic in general.[/spoiler]
